data.gender_notes: Kitaaboon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'k-t-b', meaning 'to write'. A name of praise and devotion to God, symbolizing the Quran, the sacred scripture. The name Kitaaboon carries the meaning “Book of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kitaaboon usually hope their child will grow to embody book of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Kitaaboon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Book of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kitaaboon total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
